parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere is the main globe part of the object, made of plastic with printed maps on its surface.
parts.Functional_description: It represents the Earth and can be rotated to view different continents and oceans.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its tilted axis within the supporting frame.

parts.name: Circle (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This circular ring surrounds the globe and acts as a meridian or support ring, likely made of metal.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the globe in place and allows it to rotate smoothly along its axis.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed relative to the base but allows the sphere to rotate within it.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the wooden stand that supports the entire globe structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and elevation for the globe, ensuring it remains upright and balanced.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and does not move during normal use.
